note: The payload of the AX.25 frame (GFSK 9600 bps, VHF 145.925 MHz / UHF 436.680 MHz) is not binary but comma-separated ASCII text such as "OBC,1234,5678,...". Based on the Kaitai Struct definition of satnogs-decoders (marina.ksy), the message type is decided by the leading tag string (MGS/OBC/PSU/SOL/CLS/LOD/U/V) and each field is located by its position in the comma-separated list. The RSSI conversion (value/2-134 = dBm), the hex bit-flag split of the PSU channel state and the handling of the SOL sensors' "nan" missing value (-32768) follow the formulas in marina.ksy as they are and are reliable. On the other hand, marina.ksy itself gives no scale conversion for most temperatures, currents, magnetic flux densities, accelerations and angular velocities (it just uses the integer values), so the conversion to physical units is unknown. Every label marked "(raw)" falls under this; no unit is attached. Digipeated relay messages are out of scope here (they are not structured HK telemetry). The CW beacon (de om9mar = u..r..t..p.. ar) was checked on a real recording (2026-10-22 pass): u is the total uptime in MINUTES (154448 = 9266857 s of the UHF radio / 60) and r is the UHF radio's reset count (15); t (24) matches the UHF transceiver temperature 2422/100.
note_ja: AX.25(GFSK 9600bps, VHF 145.925MHz / UHF 436.680MHz)のペイロードはバイナリではなく、"OBC,1234,5678,..."のようなカンマ区切りのASCIIテキストそのもの。satnogs-decodersのKaitai Struct定義(marina.ksy)を元に、先頭のタグ文字列(MGS/OBC/PSU/SOL/CLS/LOD/U/V)でメッセージ種別を判定し、カンマ区切りの何番目かでフィールドを特定している。RSSI変換式(値/2-134=dBm)・PSUチャンネル状態の16進ビットフラグ分解・SOLセンサの"nan"欠測値(-32768)処理はmarina.ksy記載の計算式をそのまま反映し確度が高い。一方、温度・電流・磁束密度・加速度・角速度等の多くはmarina.ksy自体がスケール変換式を持たない(整数値をそのまま使うだけの)ため、正しい物理単位への換算式は不明。ラベルに「(生値)」と付記したものは全てこれに該当し、単位は付与していない。CW(モールス)ビーコン・デジピーター中継メッセージは対象外（それぞれCW Decoderタブ・別経路の話であり、構造化されたHKテレメトリではない）。 The CW beacon (de om9mar = u..r..t..p.. ar) was checked on a real recording (2026-10-22 pass): u is the total uptime in MINUTES (154448 = 9266857 s of the UHF radio / 60) and r is the UHF radio's reset count (15); t (24) matches the UHF transceiver temperature 2422/100.
